title: Device job result
description: Request body for POST /api/device/jobs/{id}/result (agent protocol, X-Bifrost-Key device auth). The required claim_token is the UUID returned by the claim response; a wrong or stale token fails with fence_violation. The agent may report only succeeded/failed/timeout/cancelled. The server is the sole authority for status lost: if the job row is already terminal (including lost) the result is rejected with HTTP 409 job_terminal or fence_violation, and the agent must never locally re-run. Frozen for epic #818 / M0.2 #828.

claim_token.description: Fencing token from the claim response for this job; rotated on every (re)claim.

status.description: Agent-observed terminal outcome. timeout is posted only after the agent actually killed the process tree. cancelled is posted only after the agent observed the cooperative cancel flag (heartbeat hint) and stopped execution. lost is never agent-postable.

exit_code.description: Process exit code, or null when no exit code was observed (for example a spawn failure reported as failed).

duration_ms.description: Spawn-to-exit wall time in milliseconds, or null when not measured.

truncated.description: True when output hit max_output_bytes and was cut off.

error.description: Short human-readable failure or timeout reason. Must never contain device keys, control keys, enrollment tokens, or full script bodies.

output.description: Optional final output tail up to 64 KiB of UTF-8 bytes for at-a-glance history (this maxLength bounds characters only; the server enforces the byte cap). The authoritative stream is the log sequence; absence of output here is always acceptable.
